hero.subtitle: SmartChair finds barbershops, salons, spas and self-care specialists near you, shows real prices and ratings, and books your exact time instantly — all inside Telegram. No app install, no waiting on hold.

businessOS.title: Your salon, fully under control
businessOS.subtitle: One dashboard for bookings, staff schedules, services, customer history, and the numbers that tell you how business is actually going.

features.title: Everything you need to skip the wait
features.subtitle: Built for people who want great service without the chase — and businesses that want their chairs full.

map.title: Find businesses near you
map.desc: An interactive map shows every barbershop, salon, and spa around you, with distance and live availability.

filter.title: Filter & compare
filter.desc: Sort by top rated, best prices, or editor's choice to find the right specialist in seconds.

instant.title: Book instantly
instant.desc: Pick a service, specialist, date and time — your request goes out immediately, no back-and-forth.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.desc: SmartChair messages you on Telegram before your appointment so you never miss a visit.

favorites.title: Save your favorites
favorites.desc: Keep your go-to specialists and salons one tap away, and rebook your last visit instantly.

language.title: Speaks your language
language.desc: Fully available in English, Russian, and Uzbek — switch anytime from your profile.

howItWorks.title: From open chat to booked seat
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. Under a minute.

open.title: Open the bot
open.desc: Tap the link and SmartChair opens instantly inside Telegram — nothing to download.

browse.title: Browse or search
browse.desc: Explore nearby shops on the map, or search by service, rating, or price.

book.title: Pick a time & book
book.desc: Choose your specialist, service, date and time, then send your request in one tap.

confirm.title: Get confirmed
confirm.desc: Receive instant confirmation and a reminder message before your appointment.
